fields.name: Offer Letter
fields.content:
Date: {{ date }}

To,
{{ employee_name }}
{{ address }}

Subject: Offer of Employment

Dear {{ employee_name }},

We are pleased to offer you the position of {{ designation }} at Ardur Technology Private Limited. We were impressed with your skills and experience and believe you will be a valuable asset to our team.

Key Terms of Employment:

  • Start Date: {{ joining_date }}
  • Annual CTC: {{ ctc }}
  • Location: {{ location }}

This offer is subject to the verification of your credentials and successful completion of background checks.

Please sign and return the duplicate copy of this letter as a token of your acceptance.

We look forward to welcoming you aboard.

Sincerely,
For Ardur Technology Private Limited

Authorized Signatory

Date: {{ date }}

To,
{{ employee_name }}
Employee ID: {{ employee_id }}

Subject: Appointment Letter

Dear {{ employee_name }},

Further to your acceptance of our offer, we are pleased to appoint you as {{ designation }} in the {{ department }} department, effective from {{ joining_date }}.

Terms and Conditions:

  • Probation: You will be on probation for a period of {{ probation_period }} months.
  • Compensation: Your remuneration will be as per the agreed terms.
  • Policies: Your employment is governed by the company's policies and service rules.

We wish you a long and fruitful career with us.

Sincerely,
For Ardur Technology Private Limited
